images.role: the plate as 8-bit display sRGB frames (the node's image input through the working-to-sRGB display transform), at least 8 frames; the longer the move the better DPVO initialises

intrinsics.role: focal length in pixels, square pixels and the image centre as the principal point; DPVO does not estimate them, it uses what it is given

seed.role: torch, numpy and CUDA seed; fixes the random patch choice (unseeded runs differ by about 0.1 solve unit, seeded runs by about 3e-4 because the bundle adjustment kernel adds floats with CUDA atomics, so two solves are never guaranteed bit-identical: the solve is kept in the document, not recomputed)

loop_closure.role: DPV-SLAM proximity loop closure on (1) or off (0)

returns.poses: camera-to-world 4x4 per frame, OpenCV axes (x right, y down, z forward), up to scale, first frame is not the identity
returns.points: sparse patch cloud, solve units, with an 8-bit colour per point
returns.scale: the solve is monocular: scale comes from the node's unit_scale or two surveyed points

environment.gpu: NVIDIA card through CUDA only (RTX 3080 Ti, 12 GB); about 0.5 GB for a 960x540 plate

measured.translation_rms_after_similarity: about 2 cm of a 1.47 m path
